Zoey (People Ops): Late-cycle playbook for delegations and deadline patches: please follow this flow before reassigning or approving extensions.

Carlos: Quick Q  can managers transfer reviews after the form lock? We have an urgent reassign.

Zoey (People Ops): You can transfer ownership after lock but DO NOT reopen or edit scores. Use the transfer button in the form and paste the handoff note (see checklist). Transfers create an audit entry.

Nina: What's the approval window for short extensions? One manager wants +60h.

Zoey (People Ops): Managers can approve up to 48h for documented emergencies. 48-72h needs People Ops signoff (record on the approvals sheet). >72h requires VP approval. Link to sheet: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/approvals

Sam: Are contractor reviewers allowed to be transferred into? Some contractors are on NDA but not on the reviewer list.

Zoey (People Ops): Contractors OK only if on the approved-contractor-reviewer list and KBA/NDA validated. If not, assign internal backup and flag an exception.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: "Forms lock in 6 hours" scheduled at 2026-05-10 23:59 UTC.

Zoey (People Ops): Handoff checklist (paste into form comment when transferring): - TRANSFER: from @old to @new; reason - Outstanding items (count) - Confirm comments saved - Attach evidence links - Tag "transfer" for calibration sampling

Carlos: Thanks, doing the transfer now and will note outstanding comments.

Zoey (People Ops): Thanks 44d if you hit a permission bug DM me with a screenshot and thread link.
